muc.title: AI says you're out of messages
muc.text: You're chatting with AI and it says you've hit the limit and need to wait a few hours. That's a rate limit.

muc.title: Servers are limited
muc.text: Every answer uses server power, so companies share turns fairly, and free plans get fewer.

muc.title: What uses up turns
muc.text: Very long chats, large files and generating images nonstop use up your limit faster.

muc.title: Combine questions, start new chats
muc.text: Combine several points in one message, and start a new chat when you change topics to save turns.

muc.title: Three questions at once
muc.text: Put three questions you were going to ask separately into one numbered message and send it once.
